title: Roulette
intro: Pull up a chair, {name}! Tap a bet to drop a chip of {chip} on it, then hit Spin when you feel lucky.
noBets: No chips down yet. Pick a color or a number to get started.
onTable: On the table: {total} in {count} of {max} chips.
badNumber: Hmm, that's not a number from 0 to 36. Give it another go!
tooMany: That's all the chips this table takes ({max}). Spin first, or take one back with Undo.
notEnough: Easy there! You have {credits} and this spin needs {total}. Take a chip back or play a smaller chip.
poor: Easy there! You have {credits}, and one chip is {chip}. Try a smaller bet.
notYours: This is {name}'s table. Start your own with /game roulette.
haveTable: You already have a table open. Finish that one first!
sumEven: You got your chips back, so no harm done.
sumPartial: You lost {amount} overall, but a few chips came back. The next one's yours!
sumLose: Ooh, so close! You lost {amount}. The next one's yours.
closed: The table is closed. Come back anytime!
error: Something went wrong at the table, sorry! Please try again.
